1	const YahooFinance = require('yahoo-finance2').default
2	const yahooFinance = new YahooFinance()
3	
4	const quoteCache = new Map()
5	const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000 // 5 minutes
6	
7	async function getQuote(ticker) {
8	  const cached = quoteCache.get(ticker)
9	  if (cached && Date.now() - cached.ts < CACHE_TTL) return cached.data
10	
11	  const result = await yahooFinance.quote(ticker)
12	
13	  const data = {
14	    ticker: result.symbol,
15	    name: result.shortName,
16	    price: result.regularMarketPrice,
17	    change: result.regularMarketChange,
18	    changePercent: result.regularMarketChangePercent,
19	    volume: result.regularMarketVolume,
20	    marketCap: result.marketCap,
21	    dayHigh: result.regularMarketDayHigh,
22	    dayLow: result.regularMarketDayLow,
23	    open: result.regularMarketOpen,
24	    week52High: result.fiftyTwoWeekHigh,
25	    week52Low: result.fiftyTwoWeekLow,
26	    pe: result.trailingPE,
27	  }
28	
29	  quoteCache.set(ticker, { data, ts: Date.now() })
30	  return data
31	}
32	
33	async function getQuotes(tickers) {
34	  return Promise.all(tickers.map((t) => getQuote(t).catch(() => null)))
35	}
36	
37	async function getHistory(ticker, range = '3mo') {
38	  const rangeMap = { '1d': 1, '5d': 5, '1mo': 30, '3mo': 90, '6mo': 180, '1y': 365, '2y': 730 }
39	  const days = rangeMap[range] || 90
40	  const endDate = new Date()
41	  const startDate = new Date()
42	  startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - days)
43	
44	  const fmt = (d) => d.toISOString().split('T')[0]
45	
46	  const result = await yahooFinance.historical(ticker, {
47	    period1: fmt(startDate),
48	    period2: fmt(endDate),
49	    interval: '1d',
50	  })
51	
52	  return result.map((row) => ({
53	    date: row.date,
54	    open: row.open,
55	    high: row.high,
56	    low: row.low,
57	    close: row.close,
58	    volume: row.volume,
59	  }))
60	}
61	
62	async function searchTicker(query) {
63	  const results = await yahooFinance.search(query)
64	  return (results.quotes || [])
65	    .filter((q) => q.quoteType === 'EQUITY')
66	    .slice(0, 8)
67	    .map((q) => ({ ticker: q.symbol, name: q.shortname || q.longname }))
68	}
69	
70	module.exports = { getQuote, getQuotes, getHistory, searchTicker }
